title: Here U Are Anime Reveals 2nd Teaser Trailer
content: Crunchyroll revealed during its panel at the New York Comic Con 2026 on Thursday the second teaser trailer for the anime adaptation of D JUN 's Here U Are webtoon. The video features a score by the anime's musical composer and Japanese pianist Shinya Kiyozuka .
author: ANN

title: Gundam Seed Freedom Zero Prequel Anime's Trailer Reveals Theatrical Release in Japan on January 15, N. America in February 2027
content: A livestream for Mobile Suit Gundam Seed FREEDOM ZERO , the prequel to the Mobile Suit Gundam Seed FREEDOM anime film, unveiled on Friday a trailer, and it announces that the film will open in theaters in Japan on January 15 and in North America in February 2027.
author: ANN

title: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy At All First Trailer and New Cast Revealed, January 8 Premiere
content: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn’t a Guy At All anime revealed the first trailer, more voice cast, and a January 8, 2027 premiere date. The anime previously revealed new character visuals for Mitsuki and Aya.

content: Dark Horse announced during its panel at New York Comic Con 2026 on Thursday that it will release Gou Tanabe 's The Outsider and Other Early Adaptations collection, with translation by Zack Davisson . The collection feature's Tanabe's manga adaptation of H.P.

title: Live-Action 5 Centimeters Per Second Film Screens in N. America on October 23
content: GKIDS announced on Thursdady that it will begin screening the live-action film of Makoto Shinkai 's 5 Centimeters per Second anime film in North American theaters on October 23. GKIDS will reveal details about a home video release later this year.

title: Stunning New Vampire Anime Is The Castlevania Replacement Fans Needed
content: With Castlevania: Nocturne having come to an end in early 2025, anime fans have been caught in a vampire drought over the last year, which is unfortunate, as the genre as come back full force thanks to the success of massive live-action properties like Nosferatu and The Vampire Lestat breaking into the mainstream.
